title: Coming to Chicago and first music lessons
summary: He began music in Chicago in 1913 through the Catholic church and took lessons from Erskine Tate's father, with the other boys.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you start in music down there? No.
I started music at the... When I came to Chicago in 1913. I went to the Catholic Church. I'm a Catholic.

And Father Kelly was my pastor with the Reagan Colts over at 59th and Halstead. You know, not 59th and Halstead. I mean it's 55th and Halstead. And I started taking lessons from Erskine Tate's father. That's old man Jackson at 31st.

Yeah, that's right. And at that particular time you had... We were all taking lessons. All the boys were down there. And we took lessons. What I mean by taking lessons... The E-Light No. 1 was down there.
